name: DWS RREEF Real Assets Fund - Class A
summary: The DWS RREEF Real Assets Fund - Class A invests in a diversified portfolio of real assets, including real estate, infrastructure, and commodities. name: A3 Alternative Credit Fund
summary: The A3 Alternative Credit Fund seeks to generate current income and long-term capital appreciation by investing in a diversified portfolio of alternative credit investments. The fund aims to provide investors with exposure to less traditional credit strategies. It is managed to navigate diverse market conditions and provide consistent returns.

name: Virtus AllianzGI Health Sciences Fund Class P
summary: The Virtus AllianzGI Health Sciences Fund Class P aims to provide long-term capital growth by investing primarily in companies in the health sciences industry. This includes companies involved in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices, and healthcare services. The fund is managed by Allianz Global Investors, with Virtus Investment Partners serving as the distributor.

name: American Century One Choice Blend+ 2015 Portfolio Investor Class
summary: The American Century One Choice Blend+ 2015 Portfolio Investor Class is a target-date fund designed for investors planning to retire around the year 2015. The fund's asset allocation becomes more conservative over time, shifting from a greater emphasis on stocks to a greater emphasis on bonds as the target date approaches. American Century Investments manages this fund.
